title: Erased Error Types
goal: Return any error type using Box dyn Error without creating custom enums.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Error Handling

sections.text: In Java or Go, functions can return a general interface like `Exception` or `error`. In Rust, `Box<dyn std::error::Error>` plays this role.

sections.caption: Different error types convert into Box dyn Error automatically.

sections.text: The try operator calls `From::from` on errors. The standard library provides a blanket `From` implementation that boxes any type implementing `std::error::Error`.

sections.caption: Implementing Display and Error enables standard boxing.

sections.text: Dynamic errors simplify code in binaries and scripts. Libraries usually prefer explicit enums so callers can match on specific errors.

explanation: Return any error type using Box dyn Error without creating custom enums.
